bio.summary: C. Mani Krishna is a Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. Krishna received a PhD from the University of Michigan in 1984, an MS from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (1980) and a BTech from IIT Delhi (1979). Research interests include computing and cybersecurity and smart communities and infrastructure. Krishna is an IEEE Fellow.

people.name: Yann-Hang Lee
people.current_position: Emeritus Professor, School of Computing and Augmented Intelligence, Arizona State University

bio.summary: Yann-Hang Lee is an Emeritus Professor in the School of Computing and Augmented Intelligence at Arizona State University. Lee received a PhD in Computer and Information Engineering from the University of Michigan (1985), an MS from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (1982) and a BS from National Cheng Kung University (1973). Lee worked at IBM Watson Research Center and the University of Florida before joining ASU, where Lee served as program chair (2008-2013). Research covers real-time computing, embedded systems, IoT, distributed systems and performance evaluation.
